name: Toolformer
titleZh: Toolformer：语言模型可以自学使用工具
summary: Trains a model to decide which API to call, when, with what arguments, and how to fold the result back into generation, self-supervised from a handful of demonstrations per API.
summaryZh: 训练模型自己决定调哪个 API、什么时候调、传什么参数、结果怎么用回生成，全程自监督，每个 API 只要几个示例。
keyFact: Toolformer (Schick et al., arXiv:2302.04761, 2023-02-09) showed a model can teach itself to call APIs such as a calculator, search engines, a translation system and a calendar, improving zero-shot performance without giving up its core language-modelling ability.
keyFactZh: Toolformer（Schick 等，arXiv:2302.04761，2023-02-09）证明模型可以自学调用 API——计算器、搜索引擎、翻译系统、日历等——在提升零样本表现的同时不损害核心语言建模能力。
whyItMatters: It reframed tool use from an orchestration problem into a training problem, which is why "does the model call tools natively" is now a model-selection question.
whyItMattersZh: 它把工具调用从「编排问题」重新定义成了「训练问题」——这也是为什么「模型是否原生会调工具」如今成了选型问题。
title: Toolformer: Language Models Can Teach Themselves to Use Tools
